norms.title: Community guidelines
norms.lead: Nexo! is exclusively for people 18 and older. Plans are in-person meetups between adults. These rules keep everyone comfortable and safe.
norms.r1: Treat others as you’d like to be treated: no harassment, insults, or pressure.
norms.r2: Be authentic: don’t use Nexo! for spam, ads, or fake profiles.
norms.r3: If you say you’re going, try to show up. If you cancel, tell the chat early.
norms.r4: Don’t share others’ personal data or illegal / non-consensual sexual content.
norms.r5: If something’s wrong, use Report or Block. The team reviews reports.
norms.r6: 18+ only. Nobody under 18 may use Nexo! or attend a plan. Do not invite minors. If you see a profile that breaks this, report it.
norms.footnote: By using Nexo! you also accept the Terms and Privacy Policy.

help.intro: Clear answers on how to use Nexo!, create plans, manage your profile, and keep the community safe.
help.faq.what.title: What is Nexo!?
help.faq.what.body: Nexo! is an app for people 18 and older to discover and organize in-person plans nearby: sports, culture, food, and more. Join plans, create yours, and chat. It is not for minors and not for meeting minors.
help.faq.feed.title: How does the feed work?
help.faq.feed.body: The home screen shows available plans based on location, category, and filters. Open a plan to save it or join. The bottom bar takes you to chats, your plans, the feed, and profile search.
help.faq.create.title: How do I create a plan?
help.faq.create.body: Tap + on the bottom bar. Choose category, title, description, date, location, and participant limit. You can require approval to join and set visibility before publishing.
help.faq.visibility.title: Who can see a plan?
help.faq.visibility.body: When creating a plan you choose: Everyone (shows in the feed), Friends (only in your friends’ feed), or Invitees only (not in the feed; only people you invite). On invite-only plans, only the creator can send invitations.
help.faq.join.title: How do I join a plan?
help.faq.join.body: Open the plan and tap join. Open plans let you in immediately. Approval plans wait for the host. If the plan is full or you don’t meet requirements (for example women-only), you won’t be able to join.
help.faq.invite.title: How do invitations work?
help.faq.invite.body: Invite from the plan page, when creating a private plan, or from chat when allowed. The person receives it under Requests. The creator can see all pending invites for the plan and cancel any of them.
help.faq.chat.title: Where is the plan chat?
help.faq.chat.body: After you join or create a plan, it appears under Chats. There you can message the group, see members, and invite if allowed. If you leave or the host deletes the plan, the chat is no longer available.
help.faq.friends.title: How do I add friends?
help.faq.friends.body: Search profiles, open someone’s profile, and send a friend request—or do it after meeting on a plan. Manage pending requests in Friends. Friends make it easier to hang out and see Friends-only plans.
help.faq.profile.title: What appears on my profile?
help.faq.profile.body: Your name, username, photo, and optional details like age, gender, or habits. In Details you can show or hide each field. Ratings and badges also appear based on your activity.
help.faq.ratings.title: How does wrapping up a plan work?
help.faq.ratings.body: A few hours later we ask how it went. People don’t get scores: you tap faces you clicked with and, if you want, a word (Fun, Punctual…). It’s anonymous unless you both pick each other — then we tell you. Profiles show how many people would hang out again, the top highlighted trait, and if there are votes, something to improve. Organizers get stars and event-specific traits.
help.faq.block.title: How do I block someone?
help.faq.block.body: From their profile you can block them. You won’t see their plans in the usual way and they won’t join yours as before. Manage blocks in Settings → Blocked accounts.
help.faq.report.title: How do I report something?
help.faq.report.body: Report a plan or user from their screen, or send a general report from this help center. Describe what happened clearly—we review reports to protect the community. If you see someone under 18 in the app or at a plan, report it.
help.faq.age.title: Do I have to be 18 or older?
help.faq.age.body: Yes. Nexo! is only for people aged 18 or older. Plans are in-person meetups between adults. You cannot bring minors to a plan. If we find an under-18 account, we delete it.

terms.intro: By using Nexo! you accept these terms. Please read them carefully.
terms.acceptance.title: Acceptance
terms.acceptance.body: By creating an account, signing in, or otherwise using the Nexo! app, you confirm that you have read and accept these Terms and conditions and the Privacy Policy. If you disagree with any provision, you must not use the service. Continued use of Nexo! after updates are published constitutes acceptance of the updated version, unless applicable law requires additional express consent.
terms.service.title: The service
terms.service.body: Nexo! is a digital platform that helps people discover, create, and join social plans. Nexo! acts as a technology intermediary: it does not organize, supervise, or guarantee that plans take place, nor the conduct, identity, or suitability of users. Any agreement, meetup, or activity outside the app is solely the participants’ responsibility. We may modify, suspend, or discontinue the service in whole or in part for technical, security, legal, or product-improvement reasons.
terms.accounts.title: Accounts
terms.accounts.body: To use Nexo! you must be 18 or older and provide accurate, up-to-date information. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential, for activity under your account, and for the accuracy of your profile. Creating fake accounts, impersonating others, or sharing access is prohibited. We may suspend or delete accounts that breach these terms, community rules, or applicable law, or that create risk for other users or the platform.
terms.plans.title: Plans
terms.plans.body: Users who create a plan are responsible for its content (description, date, location, requirements, and any other published information) and for complying with the law when organizing the activity. Plans are in-person meetups for people 18 or older; inviting or including minors is not allowed. Nexo! may limit, hide, or remove plans, messages, or other content that violates these rules, is misleading, illegal, dangerous, or inappropriate, or that is reported on reasonable grounds. Joining a plan does not create a contractual attendance obligation toward Nexo!; expectations between participants are managed among themselves.
terms.conduct.title: Conduct
terms.conduct.body: You agree to use Nexo! respectfully and lawfully. Prohibited behavior includes, among other things: harassment, threats, discrimination, hate speech, unsolicited sexual content, violence, fraud, malware distribution, abusive automated data scraping, and any use that harms others or the service. You may report improper conduct or content in the app. Nexo! may moderate, restrict, or remove users when needed to protect the community.
terms.privacy.title: Privacy
terms.privacy.body: Processing of your personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy available in Settings. By using Nexo! you acknowledge that processing as described there. You may exercise privacy rights and, where applicable, delete your account in the app or by contacting us at hola@appnexo.es.
terms.liability.title: Liability
terms.liability.body: Nexo! is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Nexo! is not liable for damages arising from meetups between users, plan cancellations, inaccuracies in third-party profiles or content, service interruptions, data loss not attributable to willful misconduct or gross negligence, or your use of information shown in the app. Nothing in these terms limits mandatory consumer rights that cannot be excluded by contract.
terms.changes.title: Changes
terms.changes.body: We may update these Terms when needed for legal, service, or operational changes. The “Last updated” date reflects the current version. For material changes, we will try to notify you reasonably in the app. If you do not accept the new terms, you must stop using Nexo! and may delete your account.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy clearly explains how Nexo! collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal data when you use the app. It applies together with the Terms and conditions. Please read it carefully before creating an account or continuing to use the service.
privacy.controller.title: Data controller
privacy.controller.body: The controller of personal data is the operator of the Nexo! application (“Nexo!”). For any privacy question, rights request, or inquiry about this policy, contact us at hola@appnexo.es. We will handle requests within the timeframes required by applicable law.
privacy.data.title: Data we process
privacy.data.body: Depending on how you use Nexo!, we may process the following categories of data: (1) Account and identity data: email address, display name, username, and profile photo. (2) Optional profile data: age, gender, preferences, habits, or other information you choose to add, show, or hide on your profile. (3) User-generated content: plans (title, description, date and time, location, category, cover, and plan settings), messages in plan chats and direct chats, and ratings or comments between participants. (4) Social and safety data: friendships, requests, blocks, reports, saved plans, participation history, and records needed for moderation. (5) Technical and service data: session information, authentication tokens, and technical device identifiers to the extent needed to operate the app, prevent abuse, and maintain security. We do not ask for special-category data unless you voluntarily include it in free-text fields; please do not publish unnecessary information about third parties.
privacy.use.title: Purposes of processing
privacy.use.body: We process your data to: create and authenticate your account; show relevant profiles, plans, and search results; let you create or join plans, chat, save plans, and rate experiences; estimate approximate distances to plans and help with directions when you request them; manage friendships, blocks, and in-app notifications; moderate content, review reports, and prevent fraud, spam, or misuse; meet legal obligations; analyze product performance in aggregated or pseudonymized form to improve it; and handle support or rights requests. We do not sell your data to third parties for advertising.
privacy.legal.title: Legal bases
privacy.legal.body: Depending on the purpose, processing is based on: (a) performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps, where needed to provide Nexo! (account, plans, chat, ratings, etc.); (b) your consent, where required by law (for example, certain device permissions such as location, camera, or photo library, or optional processing we describe to you); (c) Nexo!’s legitimate interests in security, abuse prevention, service stability, and defending legal claims, balanced against your rights and interests; and (d) compliance with legal obligations where applicable. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
privacy.share.title: Who we share data with
privacy.share.body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with: providers that help us operate Nexo! (in particular authentication, database, and file storage infrastructure, currently via Supabase); map or geocoding providers when you search or resolve locations (queries may include address text or coordinates); and other Nexo! users to the extent you publish or share information (visible profile, plans, messages, ratings). We may also disclose data when required by law, by a competent authority, or to protect the rights, safety, and integrity of users or Nexo!. We require appropriate confidentiality and security measures from our providers given the nature of the service.
privacy.location.title: Location
privacy.location.body: The app may request access to your location only when needed for specific features, such as estimating distance to a plan or helping you get directions. Permission is requested in an in-app use context (“while using the app”) and you may deny or revoke it in system settings; in that case, some location-based features will be unavailable. Nexo! does not continuously track your location in the background for profiling. Locations associated with a plan are those entered or selected by the creator (or derived from their search) and are shown to people who can view that plan.
privacy.media.title: Photos, camera, and gallery
privacy.media.body: With your prior permission, Nexo! may access the device camera or photo library so you can upload a profile photo, plan cover, or chat images, depending on available features. Those files are hosted in our managed storage (Supabase Storage) and linked to your account, plan, or conversation. You must not upload illegal or offensive content or content that infringes third-party rights. We may remove or restrict reported content or content that breaches community rules.
privacy.retention.title: Retention
privacy.retention.body: We keep your data while your account remains active and as needed to provide the service. If you delete your account in Settings, Nexo! deletes the account, profile, associated content, and files you own in Nexo! storage. We may retain limited moderation records, anonymized data, or information required by law to prevent abuse or establish, exercise, or defend legal claims. Deleted plans and files become unavailable.
privacy.security.title: Security
privacy.security.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures aimed at protecting data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or improper disclosure. These include authenticated access to the service, database access controls, and encrypted transmission via HTTPS. No system is completely infallible; please protect your device, do not share passwords, and report suspicious access. If a security incident affecting your personal data occurs and the law requires it, we will inform you and notify the competent authority when applicable.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: Where the GDPR or other applicable law grants you rights, you may request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing, and portability, and withdraw consent where processing is based on it. You may also delete your account directly in the app. To exercise rights, email hola@appnexo.es with a clear request; we may ask for reasonable information to verify your identity. If you live in the EU/EEA, you may lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (in Spain, the Spanish Data Protection Agency — AEPD).
privacy.minors.title: Minors
privacy.minors.body: Nexo! is intended only for people aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. Plans are in-person meetups for adults only: a minor may not use the app or attend a plan. If we become aware that an account was created by someone under 18, we will take steps to delete it and erase or anonymize associated data as soon as possible. If you are a parent or guardian and believe a minor has provided us with data, contact us at hola@appnexo.es.
privacy.transfers.title: International transfers
privacy.transfers.body: Some infrastructure or auxiliary service providers may process data from countries outside the European Economic Area. Where that happens, we apply appropriate safeguards under applicable law (for example, Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission or other valid mechanisms), plus supplementary security measures when needed. You may request more information about these transfers by contacting hola@appnexo.es.
privacy.local.title: On-device data
privacy.local.body: To improve performance and user experience, Nexo! may store on your device preferences (such as language), chat read markers, temporary caches, and UI state. This information stays on the device unless it must sync with our servers to provide the related feature. You can clear local data by uninstalling the app or, depending on the operating system, clearing the app’s storage.
privacy.changes.title: Changes to this policy
privacy.changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in the service, the law, or our practices. The “Last updated” date indicates the current version. For material changes, we will try to notify you reasonably through the app. Continued use of the service after the new version takes effect means you are aware of the updated policy, without prejudice to your rights.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: For any question about this Privacy Policy, the processing of your data, or exercising your rights, contact Nexo! at hola@appnexo.es. We will aim to reply clearly and within a reasonable time under applicable law.
